column1: # The English for the name over an enemy's HP bar -- the plate that reads
# ジャハルッカス or 魔物兵(25匹) while a fight is on. Hand-written; this is the file
# The Japanese is copied from game/extracted/enemy_party_names.v1.04.tsv, which
# scripts/extract_enemy_party_names.js writes, and the order is the game's own --
# the Monster Army first, the Fiends last. A name left out here stays Japanese in
# Keyed by the Japanese rather than by string slot, because a slot belongs to one
# build of one version and because 45 of these names share theirs with something
# else. The build renders this into an override of Enemy@Id::get rather than into
# translated strings; modules/EnemyPartyNames.js says why, and
# docs/enemy-party-names.md has the whole of it.
# The suffixes the game appends are not here and must not be written in: 難易度調整
# adds + or v for a rebalanced fight and (25匹) for a group, and the .jaf takes
# those off before it looks a name up.
# glossaries/card_name_glossary.tsv; the terms follow the dialogue, which is what
# scripts/lookup_term.js is for -- 中隊 a Company, 大隊 a Battalion, 闘将 a Fighting
# General, 鬼 an oni, 群生 a colony.
